prompt: new ticket from the sieportal team on AKS: their workloads select nodes with nodeSelector agentpool=<poolname> and they've noticed nodes CAST provisions get stamped agentpool=castai no matter what they put in the node template, so their pods never land on CAST nodes. they're asking if there's a way to make CAST nodes carry their own agentpool value, or barring that, what the supported way to target CAST node pools is. what do i tell them?

assertions.text: Identifies agentpool and/or kubernetes.azure.com/agentpool as CAST AI reserved labels whose values are overwritten
Explains that AKS requires every node to carry a pool identity label, which is why CAST AI stamps its own value and cannot honor custom ones
Does NOT claim that a node template can set a custom agentpool value or that CAST nodes can join a customer-named Azure agent pool
Gives the supported alternative: one node template per pool, targeted with the scheduling.cast.ai/node-template label (and/or template custom labels)
Offers a migration path for existing workloads (e.g., PodMutation to rewrite legacy selectors, or updating manifests to the new label)
Cites at least one official CAST AI source (docs.cast.ai, api.cast.ai spec, changelog, or github.com/castai)
